                    dp[j][0] = min(dp[j][0], time_to_j)

            elif d[j] < d[i]:

                time_to_j = dp[i][0] + dist
                wait_time = ((time_to_j + r) // (g + r)) * (g + r)
                if wait_time - time_to_j <= r:
